## Notes
- Editorial scores are estimates based on published retailer specifications and verified-buyer feedback, not independent lab tests.
- Products are intimate companion products for adults. Reviews cover materials, build quality, care and value only.
- Retailer: Quzio (quziostore.com). We may earn a commission on qualifying purchases.
